newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian woman killed in black magic ritual.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian woman killed in black magic ritual.

text.p: A 48-year-old woman was killed during a black magic ritual in front of her two sons on the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro, police said on Monday.

Iara Pires de Souza Neves was strangled and had her eyes and tongue ripped out with a knife on Saturday night by Marlene Damasceno de Souza, 37, a "priestess" of the Afro-Brazilian religion of Macumba, a police spokesman said.
Souza also burned the chest of her victim with a clothes iron and stuffed a wooden cup into her mouth while Neves' sons aged 8 and 14 were forced to watch, he said.

Screams attracted the attention of neighbours who called police. Souza's husband found his wife naked on the floor bathing herself in the blood of her victim and smoking a pipe. The two boys were found in a state of shock.
Souza told police she was exorcising evil spirits.
